data.one_liner: Flutter loading buttons with state machine, success/error states and animated thinking-orbs.
data.what_it_does: Provides customizable Flutter loading buttons with built-in idle, loading, success, error, and disabled states. Includes animated thinking-orb indicators for AI interfaces and support for controllers and progress indicators.
use_when: You need buttons that transition through loading, success, and error states
You want animated thinking-orb indicators for AI or agent interfaces
You need to drive button states externally via a controller or boolean flags
avoid_when: You require complex form validation handling directly inside the button
You only need standard native Material buttons without any loading states
strengths: Supports multiple button types (elevated, filled, outlined, text, icon)
Includes built-in animated thinking-orbs for AI interfaces
Offers both widget-owned and controller-driven state management
Pure Dart with zero external dependencies
weaknesses: Legacy default dimensions require manual opt-in to content sizing
Some default colour strategies are not dark-mode safe without explicit configuration
data.minimal_example:
LoadingButton(
  onPressed: () async => submit(),
  onSuccess: () => debugPrint('done'),
  child: const Text('Submit'),
)
